PRIOR_QUALITY.description: Prior belief about specimen performance quality (baseline before measurement)
PRIOR_QUALITY.prediction: Z2 to state trigger reversal window
PRIOR_QUALITY.falsifier: Quality does not recover to 0.75+ within proposed window

PRIOR_ACCEPTANCE.description: Prior belief about task acceptance rate (prior to observation)
PRIOR_ACCEPTANCE.prediction: Z2 to state trigger reversal window
PRIOR_ACCEPTANCE.falsifier: Acceptance rate does not recover to 0.85+ within proposed window

SHRINK.description: Shrinkage weight for acceptance rate forecast; blends prior 0.85 with observed rate: forecast = SHRINK * observed + (1 - SHRINK) * prior
